interpretation: Verified Human Network messaging is generating stronger quality engagement from Builder audiences when framed around reliability and signal quality, with repeat engagement building from named AI Lab and evaluation-team accounts.
Verification appears to be a stronger credibility driver for technical Builder audiences than for Creator audiences — Creators engage with the proof but don't progress as deep into the content.

Workflow-integration framing is producing narrow but high-quality engagement from engineering and evaluation teams — reach is small, but the audience that clicks reads through the full technical story.
API and integration framing has almost no pull with Creator audiences. This topic should remain scoped to Builder segments rather than adapted broadly.
Real-time human reaction is not yet a differentiated hook for Builders — this audience responds more to verification and workflow-integration proof than to creative-feedback framing.
Immediate human feedback is the strongest-performing idea in the Creator portfolio: before/after variants are producing the deepest content progression measured across any audience-topic pairing.
